demographics.trauma_type: Accidentally caused serious injury to another

Maladaptive Strategies.value: I put on loud music or TV

Threat.value: Even when others tell me I am safe I find it impossible to believe it

Memory.value: Remembering the event brings back the same terror I felt at the time
My memories of the frightening event are like a film that plays over and over.
When I remember the event I feel intense guilt

Negative Appraisals.value: I can't trust that I will do the right thing
I will never forgive myself for not doing more to stop what happened
I should have protected others and I failed

issues.item: Memory: Rage on Recall: When I remember the event I feel intense rage
issues.explanation: For a trauma of accidentally causing serious injury to another person, the memory cluster is otherwise dominated by terror, replay, and guilt-based appraisals. Intense rage on recall is not impossible, but here it lacks any supporting appraisal or threat content indicating anger at another person, blame, or perceived hostility; it sits awkwardly with the rest of the profile.

issues.item: Threat: Threat in Movements: Sudden movements by others put me immediately on guard
issues.explanation: The threat profile centers on generalized unsafety and hyperarousal, but 'sudden movements by others put me immediately on guard' suggests an interpersonal attack/assault-style threat cue. With an accidental-injury trauma and no trigger/appraisal content about hostile others, this item is hard to integrate with the rest of the formulation.

issues.item: Rage on Recall: When I remember the event I feel intense rage
issues.explanation: For trauma type 'accidentally caused serious injury to another', the profile is dominated by guilt, self-blame, and terror, which is coherent; however, intense rage on recall is hard to integrate clinically here because there is no corresponding appraisal of blame toward others, betrayal, or anger-based threat context elsewhere in the profile. It stands out as inconsistent with the rest of the formulation.

issues.item: Threat in Movements: Sudden movements by others put me immediately on guard
issues.explanation: 'Sudden movements by others put me immediately on guard' implies a hypervigilant interpersonal/assault-like threat context. In this profile, triggers are absent and the appraisals/memory content center on guilt about having failed someone in an accident. Without any assaultive or aggression-related memory/appraisal content, this threat item is difficult to reconcile with the specified trauma context and the rest of the node content.
